sents.t: On Saturday morning, Rosa invites me to her apartment for breakfast.
Her kitchen is yellow and bright, and it smells wonderful.
“Do you like pancakes, Sam?” she asks.
“I don’t know. I never eat pancakes!”
The table is full of food: pancakes, eggs, bacon, and a big bowl of fruit.
Rosa puts maple syrup on my pancakes.
“This is very American,” she says.
I try a pancake.
It is soft and sweet.
“Mmm, delicious!”
Rosa drinks orange juice.
I drink coffee with milk.
Max sits under the table.
He looks at the bacon with big eyes.
“No, Max. Bacon is not for dogs,” Rosa says.
In my country, we usually eat bread, cheese, tomatoes, and olives for breakfast.
“That sounds nice and healthy,” Rosa says.
“Next time, you make breakfast!”
After breakfast, I wash the dishes.
Rosa says, “Thank you, Sam. You are a good neighbor.”

comp.q: When is breakfast at Rosa’s apartment?
comp.fa: صبحانه در آپارتمان رزا کی است؟

comp.q: What does Rosa put on Sam’s pancakes?
comp.fa: رزا روی پنکیک‌های سام چه می‌ریزد؟

comp.q: What do people in Sam’s country eat for breakfast?
comp.fa: مردم کشور سام برای صبحانه چه می‌خورند؟

comp.q: What does Sam do after breakfast?
comp.fa: سام بعد از صبحانه چه کار می‌کند؟
